content: Evaluate the utilization of health-related mobile applications designed to assist in diabetes management, including features such as blood glucose tracking, medication reminders, and dietary guidance. Assess the effectiveness and reliability of online resources that provide educational materials, support tools, and evidence-based information for individuals with diabetes. Examine the role and functionality of patient portals in facilitating communication between patients and healthcare providers, enabling access to medical records, test results, and personalized care plans.
